comparison.objective: Cut tubing to length with a tubing cutter.
comparison.physical_skill: Align and clamp a rotary cutter, orbit it around the tube, and progressively tighten it while maintaining a square cut.
comparison.success_condition: Tube is fully severed at the intended location with an acceptably square, undamaged cut and controlled separated pieces.
comparison.reason: Both involve controlled separation, but tubing cutting uses progressive circumferential cutting of the workpiece; the candidate requires impact fracture of internal tangs while retaining surrounding inserts and recovering four tiny fragments.
